benefit_text: The scheme provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months to each eligible family.
who_can_apply: Landholding farmer families that have cultivable land in their names are eligible. Institutional land holders, members of constitutional posts, ministers, MPs, mayors, government officers, pensioners earning ₹10,000 or more, tax payers and professionals are excluded.
documents: Aadhaar card, landholding papers, and savings bank account are required.
how_to_apply: Visit the PM‑Kisan portal, choose New Farmer Registration, enter Aadhaar and mobile number, verify with OTP, fill details, upload Aadhaar, land and bank documents, then submit.
